english.title: Fail to notify competent authority of recovery of stolen or lost driver disqualification card / NVT Certificate etc

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Vehicle Drivers Certificates of Professional Competence Regulations 2007

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been issued with

(A)_[a driver disqualification card]_
(B)_[a national driver qualification card]_
(C)_[an NVT certificate]_

which, having been reported as damaged, lost or stolen, was subsequently found,

(D)_[failed to return the document, now in your possession, to the competent authority]_
(E)_[failed, having become aware that it had been found, to take all reasonable steps to take possession of it and, if successful, return it to the competent authority]_

as soon as practicable
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 8B(4), (5) and (6) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
having been issued a driver disqualification card / national driver qualification card / NVT certificate and having notified the competent authority of its loss or theft
under regulation 8B(1) of the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007
failed when the card or certificate was found and was in his / her possession
to return it to the competent authority OR
it not being in your possession
to take all reasonable steps to take possession of it and return it to the competent authority as soon as practicable

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence applies from the 3rd December 2024 due to changes made by SI 2024/1160 to the Vehicle Drivers (Certificates of Professional Competence) Regulations 2007.
